rounds.label: the lobe storm dies; the residual turns out to be a physics limit
rounds.headline: An anchor-relative amplitude floor kills M26's lone-knock ring storm at every decay from 25 to 80 ms, and keeps the held-out pass exactly (desk 20/20, soft 20/20, lap 20/20, 0 FP, p95 203.9 ms). Real rescues sit at 0.382-1.328 of their anchor; storm lobes at 0.031-0.131. A factor of three, with nothing in between.
rounds.biggest_gap: The guard is a no-op on every byte of real data the project owns, so all evidence it works is synthetic - and a critic showed two COMPARABLE contacts 150 ms apart still fire, at ratios inside the real-gesture band. No amplitude statistic can exclude that, because two comparable contacts 100-220 ms apart is what a double-tap is. Three rounds running have now ended at the same missing 10 minutes: the corpus holds zero lap confound recordings.
